svg.text: Counting time to a TOTAL precision p, statistical plus the systematic from an uncertain f (dark 13:20 + light 13:59, equal-time off run)
A. N = 10 counts/s, f = 10 %: time to total p = 10 % against level
B. Same N and f: time at the best level against target p
C. N = 100 counts/s, f = 10 %: time to total p = 10 % against level
D. Same N and f: time at the best level against target p
eps(v) from room-light scans (light 13:59, light 17:24); b(v) from the 2026-11-10 dark scans (dark 13:20, dark 16:36), fitted by selftest._smooth_dark_rate. R8486 at ~1000 V
(operator; HV not in the files). The photon background is a MODEL: fraction f of the signal, same pulse heights, absent from the off run.
A, C: every finite curve is the statistics-only curve times the same factor 1 / (1 - floor^2 / p^2), so on a log axis they are parallel and the best level and the levels
within 5 % of the best TIME do not change with delta_f. B, D: dotted verticals are the systematic floors; the time diverges as p approaches each one (N = 10: best level 6.0
mV, the photon-free optimum at N' = 11; N = 100: best level 5.6 mV, the photon-free optimum at N' = 110). T is the length of each run (on and off); clock time 2T.
